mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tax_period (id, registration_id, period_start, period_end, filing_due_date, payment_due_date, reporting_currency, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.registrationId}, #{row.periodStart}, #{row.periodEnd}, #{row.filingDueDate}, #{row.paymentDueDate}, #{row.reportingCurrency}, #{row.status}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, registration_id, period_start, period_end, filing_due_date, payment_due_date, reporting_currency, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_period WHERE registration_id = #{registrationId} AND period_start = #{periodStart} AND period_end = #{periodEnd}
SELECT id, registration_id, period_start, period_end, filing_due_date, payment_due_date, reporting_currency, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_period WHERE id IN #{v} ORDER BY id
